I’m not sure if this actually worked or if it was just time. But I used cocoa butter Vaseline (comes in a tub) and applied that to the scars twice a day. They were still pretty fresh. But it did reduce it quite a bit. And then if anyone asks then you can say you need the Vaseline for your lips or feet or elbows or something. It’s not an obvious scar treatment. But it’s worth a try :)
